text:
anya: Heads up — stg-runtime1 started throwing OOMs at ~15:21 UTC after the kernel swap we rolled 10:00. Long chat sessions (~14-18k tokens) seem affected. KV page count spikes then thrashes.
marc: saw alerts. any profiler link?
anya: here's flame + kvmap dump: https://s3.redwood-internal/profiles/1769501234/kv-thrash.html
zhao: interesting — kernel selection moved to faster tiled-attn kernel, which increases kv prefetch window. Could be prefetching beyond slab limits.
marc: we also changed batching heuristic to prefer larger batches for throughput at 8k+ seq — might be increasing per-request kv footprint.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary 2026-03-17T09:00 deployed to stg-runtime1
radek: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T15:21:09Z OOM: kv_pages_alloc 121MB > slab_limit 96MB
kv_prefetch_items=32 prefetch_pages=48
```
anya: repro notes: single long chat -> many small generative calls (streaming) so prefix reuse is low; we keep re-allocating kv pages.
sophia: hmm, reuse policy currently tags entries by session+turn, but if kernel changes the page_stride we can't reuse same pages -> fragmentation.
zhao: that explains fragmentation growth. Kernel picks change the serialized key size, kvmap collision rate increases, older entries not reused -> evictions and small leftover fragments.
marc: short-term mitigation: reduce prefetch window and cap per-request kv_pages to 24, add eviction-priority for same-session entries.
anya: rolled patch to stg: reduce_prefetch=24 cap_kv_pages=24. Monitoring now.
ops-bot: metric alert cleared for stg-runtime1 at 15:37 UTC :white_check_mark:
radek: longer term: need kernel-agnostic kv key format or normalize at runtime. also consider soft-degrade where we fallback to quantized CPU kernel when kv mem delta > X.
sophia: also add a retry path that drops prefetch and forces compact_reuse before retry; keeps streaming latencies stable.
zhao: I'll open an RFC for kernel-key normalization + batching heuristic guardrails. tagging @marc @anya
marc: thx. can we add a canary that exercises long-context sessions under each kernel variant?
anya: yes, I'll add synthetic user tests to perf harness and run 24h soak.
marc: great. please post follow-up when RFC and canary are live.
